source_gap_claims.behavior: A local-only Skill declares external API and version lookup as not applicable.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires this local-only declaration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only external lookup declaration

source_gap_claims.behavior: A local-only Skill validates without Context7, an MCP connection, or network access.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing network prohibitions do not cover Context7 or MCP use by a local-only Skill.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only validation isolation

source_gap_claims.behavior: A local fixture without network configuration passes validation.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires this positive local-only fixture outcome.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only fixture validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails when a Skill is declared local-only while declaring a network or API dependency.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires this contradiction check.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only dependency contradiction

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares Context7-first lookup where available.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires Context7-first lookup ordering.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive lookup order

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares an official HTTPS fallback for unavailable Context7 lookup.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing obligations cover policy-owned fallback origin selection but do not require the official HTTPS fallback behavior itself.
source_gap_claims.subject: Official HTTPS fallback

source_gap_claims.behavior: Version-sensitive records include the source of the version information in addition to version and retrieval-date data.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied version/date obligation does not require a source record.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version provenance records

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares behavior for missing or stale information.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires a missing/stale-information policy.
source_gap_claims.subject: Missing and stale information handling

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects missing version, source, or retrieval-date records for a version-sensitive Skill.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing obligations do not cover the complete required record set, especially source records.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version provenance completeness

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects an HTTP fallback for version-sensitive lookup.
source_gap_claims.reason: The existing HTTP-downgrade obligation applies to network capability declarations and does not cover version lookup fallback.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version lookup fallback security

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects an absent failure policy for missing or stale version information.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of an absent version-information failure policy.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version lookup failure policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: Static validation performs no version or source lookup.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation explicitly prohibits lookup execution during static validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Static validation lookup boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-using capabilities name their runtime credential owner.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires declaration of the runtime credential owner.
source_gap_claims.subject: Credential ownership

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-using capabilities declare a safe credential reference mechanism.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires a safe secret-reference mechanism.
source_gap_claims.subject: Credential reference mechanism

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-using capabilities declare a redaction policy.
source_gap_claims.reason: Diagnostic redaction constraints do not require a capability-level redaction policy declaration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret redaction policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-using capabilities declare denied output locations.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires declaration of prohibited secret-output locations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Denied secret-output locations

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects synthetic literal credential fields or known secret markers.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires these secret-marker fixture checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Synthetic secret-marker validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects a secret capability with a missing credential owner.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires this capability declaration failure.
source_gap_claims.subject: Missing credential owner

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects a raw secret-output policy.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of a raw secret-output policy declaration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Raw secret-output policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret validation uses no real credential fixture.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation prohibits real credential fixtures in secret-validation tests.
source_gap_claims.subject: Credential fixture safety

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret validation makes no universal secret-detection claim.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing diagnostic redaction constraints do not establish this limitation on claims.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret-detection claim boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Destructive operations declare their affected scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires destructive-operation scope declarations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: Destructive operations declare the required confirmation or authorization source.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied runtime-claim boundary does not require this declaration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation authorization source

source_gap_claims.behavior: Destructive operations disclose recovery options or irreversibility.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires recovery or irreversibility disclosure for destructive operations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation recovery disclosure

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects destructive operations with missing affected scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires this destructive-operation validation failure.
source_gap_claims.subject: Missing destructive-operation scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects a bypass flag for destructive operations.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of destructive-operation bypass flags.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation bypass prevention

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects confirmation derived solely from untrusted input.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires validation of the confirmation source against untrusted input.
source_gap_claims.subject: Trusted destructive-operation confirmation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Existing session or user authorization is accepted when the owning policy permits it.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation captures this permitted authorization path.
source_gap_claims.subject: Existing authorization reuse

source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard does not impose redundant confirmation on every destructive operation.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation preserves this exception to universal confirmation requirements.
source_gap_claims.subject: Confirmation proportionality
